newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla cattle lightly traded at $65 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla cattle lightly traded at $65 - USDA.

text.p: Trade very slow in the panhandle area early Wednesday.
Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 300 head slaughter steers and 100 heifers; 75,100 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 14,900 head formulated and 300 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 65.00.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1100 lbs 65.00.
